name: Door supervisors
short: Licensed door teams who check ID, manage the queue and deal with trouble calmly, by the book.
title: Door supervisors in Manchester
description: SIA-licensed door supervisors for bars, clubs and venues in Manchester. Every officer's licence number before the shift, a written report after it.
headline: Calm on the door, all night.
lede: SIA-licensed door supervisors for bars, clubs, late venues and private functions. They are the first people your guests meet, so we send officers who are firm, polite and easy to deal with.

includes.p: Checking age and condition at the door, applying your admissions policy and keeping the queue moving.
Regular walks of the floor, toilets and smoking areas, so problems are spotted before they grow.
Officers trained in conflict management, who talk people down first and record every incident.
First aid training, and every treatment written up for your accident book.

faqs.a: Yes. Every officer holds an SIA door supervisor licence, and we send you the name and licence number of each one before the shift.

faqs.q: Can we have the same officers each week?
faqs.a: Tell us when you book. We plan rotas so regular venues see familiar faces wherever we can.

faqs.q: How much notice do you need?
faqs.a: For planned work, two to three days. For urgent cover, call 020 3757 2767: we can often send officers within hours.

name: Event security
short: Planning and staffing from the first risk assessment to the last car out of the car park.
title: Event security in Manchester
description: Event security for concerts, festivals, sport and private events across the North West: planning, gates and searches, crowds, and a named supervisor.
headline: From the first gate to the last car out.
lede: Security for concerts, festivals, sporting fixtures, corporate events and private functions. We plan with you, staff the event with licensed officers and run it on the day.

includes.p: We walk the site, read your plans and agree numbers, positions and timings before anyone is booked.
Ticket and bag checks that keep queues short and stay polite.
Officers placed where crowds build: entrances, bars, stage fronts and exits.
A named supervisor runs the team on the day and is your single point of contact.

faqs.q: How many officers will we need?
faqs.a: It depends on the crowd, the site and the licence conditions. Send us the details and we will recommend a number and explain why.

faqs.q: Can you work with our event management company?
faqs.a: Yes. We plan with whoever is running the event and follow the agreed event plan.

faqs.q: How much notice do you need?
faqs.a: As much as you can give. For large events, talk to us early so we can plan the team properly.

name: Retail security

title: Retail security officers in Manchester
description: Uniformed and plain-clothes security officers for shops and retail parks in Manchester, trained in loss prevention and customer service.
headline: Fewer losses, and a shop floor that still feels friendly.
lede: Uniformed and plain-clothes officers for shops and retail parks. A visible officer puts most thieves off; the ones who try anyway meet someone who knows the law and keeps calm.

includes.p: Uniformed officers at entrances and on the floor, so customers feel safe and thieves move on.
Store detectives for persistent losses, working to the law on stopping and detaining a suspect.
Officers who help customers and staff, not just watch them.
Every incident written up, so you have a record for the police and your insurer.

faqs.a: Uniformed officers deter; plain-clothes officers catch persistent offenders. Many shops use both. We will advise once we know where the losses are.
Yes. Tell us the sites and hours and we will plan the cover across them.

name: Office security
short: Officers who know your building, your staff and who should be signing in.
title: Office and reception security in Manchester
description: Security officers for offices, receptions and headquarters in Manchester: access control, reception and patrols, briefed on your building.
headline: Officers who know who should be signing in.
lede: Uniformed officers for offices, receptions and headquarters. We brief them on your building, your people and your procedures, so they protect the place without getting in the way of work.

includes.p: Checking passes, signing in visitors and keeping doors that should be shut, shut.
A professional first face for visitors, who knows your staff and your procedures.
Regular checks of floors, plant rooms, car parks and fire exits, logged with times.
One plan and one point of contact across all of your buildings.

faqs.q: Can officers follow our own procedures?
faqs.a: Yes. Give us your site instructions and we brief every officer on them before their first shift.

faqs.q: Do you provide cover for holidays and sickness?
faqs.a: Yes. If your regular officer is away, we send a replacement who has been briefed on your site.

name: Mobile patrols

title: Mobile patrols and keyholding in Manchester

headline: Unannounced visits, every one logged.
lede: Security without a full-time officer on site. Our patrol officers visit at irregular times through the night, hold your keys and respond when your alarm goes off.

includes.p: Unannounced visits at irregular times, checking doors, windows, gates and fences.
We hold your keys securely, so you are not the one called out at 3am.
An officer attends when your alarm is triggered, checks the site and secures it.
Times, findings and photos for each visit, so you can see the work was done.

faqs.a: As many as the site needs. We will suggest a pattern once we know the site and the risk.

faqs.q: Is a patrol cheaper than a static officer?
faqs.a: Usually, yes. Patrols suit sites that need checking rather than constant presence. We will tell you honestly which one your site needs.

includes.p: Your cameras watched remotely during the hours you choose.
A patrol officer or the police sent when an incident needs it.
